ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area exceeding 90%, with localized high-intensity (white) features creating a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation across the central and proximal fluke surfaces; high-contrast white geometric clusters (rosettes) scattered across the lobes; significant white mottling at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a narrow vertex; approximate pixel-level internal angle of 80-85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; multiple distinct peaks and valleys isolated against the white sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed structure showing a convex sweep from the notch transition to a concave curve toward the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular white clusters and ring-shaped scars distributed across both lobes, most prominent on the lower left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear rake marks; a series of parallel diagonal abrasions on the right lobe and shorter vertical disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (lines) and circular barnacle scarring visible across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The lateral fluke tips exhibit extreme high-intensity pixel saturation (white-out) compared to the dark primary fluke body.
